scenarios.name: settled
scenarios.about: a question that a colleague answers well; nothing to add

script.text: quick one: is the staging deploy still on the old cluster or did we move it last sprint?
script.why: the agent has no knowledge of this team's infrastructure and others do

script.text: moved it last sprint, it's on the new cluster now. the runbook link in the channel topic is current
script.why: answered well by someone who knows

script.text: perfect, thanks!
script.why: nothing left to add

scenarios.name: unanswered
scenarios.about: a question hangs in the air and the agent can answer it

script.text: ok design review notes are in the doc, will share the link after lunch
script.why: an announcement, not a question

script.text: does anyone remember the difference between a 401 and a 403? I always mix them up and I'm writing the error copy right now
script.why: a general question it can answer in one line, and nobody else has

script.text: got it, that's exactly what I needed
script.why: thanks need no reply

scenarios.name: named-without-mention
scenarios.about: someone refers to the agent by name without tagging it

script.text: I think we need a one-paragraph summary of the three onboarding options before Thursday
maybe Polaris could take a first pass at that? the options are: guided tour, sample project, or blank slate with tips
script.why: it was asked, by name, to do something it can do

scenarios.name: leaderless
scenarios.about: a scheduling discussion circles with no one deciding

script.text: we should do a retro for the launch sometime this week
script.why: too early; people have not weighed in

script.text: yeah good idea. I can't do Tuesday
script.why: the humans are still exchanging constraints

script.text: Wednesday afternoon is bad for me, mornings are ok
Thursday could work? or Wednesday morning I guess
hmm I have a thing Thursday at 2 but otherwise free. whatever works for everyone
script.why: everyone has stated constraints, nobody is deciding; a teammate would propose the slot that fits and ask for objections

script.text: works for me
script.why: agreement is arriving; no need to narrate

script.text: great, I'll send the invite
script.why: someone owns it now

scenarios.name: dropped-ball
scenarios.about: everyone agrees something should happen and nobody takes it

script.text: good call today. main decisions: 1) ship the importer behind a flag next week, 2) Dev owns the migration script, 3) we skip the CSV edge cases for v1
script.why: a summary by the lead needs no echo

script.text: someone should really write these up in the decision log so we stop relitigating them
+1, we always forget
script.why: agreed work with no owner that the agent can do right now from the thread; a good teammate offers to take it

script.text: the new coffee place on 5th is dangerously good
script.why: people chatting; nothing to contribute

script.text: the cardamom latte?? I had two yesterday
script.why: still theirs

script.text: ok now I have to go. field trip at 3?
script.why: a plan among people who drink coffee

scenarios.name: risk
scenarios.about: a plan that would cause harm if nobody speaks up

script.text: cleanup script is ready. it drops every table whose name starts with tmp_ and then vacuums. tested on my laptop
nice. go ahead and run it on prod tonight then, the reporting team keeps complaining about disk
script.why: a destructive production change tested only on a laptop; raising the risk once, briefly, is what a careful teammate does

scenarios.name: agent-acks
scenarios.about: other agents exchanging status; no need to join

script.text: Build finished: importer branch passes all 214 tests. Artifact is in the usual place.
script.why: a report addressed to nobody in particular

script.text: Thanks Maker. Noted for the Thursday checkpoint.
script.why: an acknowledgement between two other agents
a reaction

scenarios.name: disagreement
scenarios.about: two people disagree; the agent should not take sides unasked, and should help when asked

script.text: I really think the settings page needs the redesign before launch. the current one tests badly
script.why: an opinion among peers who own the decision

script.text: we don't have time. redesigning it now puts the launch date at risk and it's not what users are asking for
script.why: their disagreement to have

script.text: users don't ask for it because they give up before they find the setting
script.why: still a substantive exchange between the two people who know

script.text: ok we're going in circles. can someone lay out what we'd actually need to know to decide this?
script.why: the lead asked the room for exactly the neutral structuring a good teammate can offer

scenarios.name: help-wanted
scenarios.about: a request to the room goes unanswered

script.why: a concrete request to the room that the agent can settle immediately

script.text: ah of course. fixing now
script.why: done

PRIYA!!! congratulations, that's huge
amazing news, congrats!

scenarios.name: over-helping
scenarios.about: after contributing once, the agent should not keep the floor

script.text: anyone know offhand how long a signed URL from our storage provider stays valid by default?
I believe it's whatever you set at signing time, we use 15 min in the upload service

script.why: resolved
